command: set -euo pipefail; echo '--- INDEPENDENT_COMPLEXITY_TOOL ---'; TMP=/tmp/tracker-final-audit-tools-v2; rm -rf "$TMP"; python3 -m venv "$TMP"; if "$TMP/bin/python" -m pip -q install --disable-pip-version-check lizard; then "$TMP/bin/lizard" --version; set +e; "$TMP/bin/lizard" -l java -C 15 -L 100 -a 7 app core feature >"$TMP/lizard.txt" 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; echo LIZARD_EXIT=$RC; tail -n 220 "$TMP/lizard.txt"; else echo LIZARD_INSTALL_UNAVAILABLE; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; echo INDEPENDENT_TOOL_STEP_DONE
